subject: Mutual Action Plan & final execution play — signature timing and Day One readiness
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@farsidehealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan draft and proposal for go/no-go cadence

Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for the time this morning. As promised, attached is a draft MAP (MAP_v3.pdf) that breaks our joint evaluation into a two-week technical POC followed by a one-week production readiness window and then a final go/no-go decision. High level:

- Week 1 (POC): model onboarding, sample traffic tests, latency and token-cost baselines.
- Week 2 (POC): edge cases, prompt regressions, end-to-end throughput.
- Week 3 (Readiness): SLA checks, KV/prefix caching test, rollout plan and ops runbook.

We recommend the formal go/no-go meeting include your engineering manager + procurement and our product lead + legal (we can bring a brief SOW). Proposed decision window: Friday, July 2 (we can be flexible).

Please review the MAP and let me know:
1) who from your side will own each MAP row (POC lead, security reviewer, procurement), and
2) any fixed blackout dates for the evaluation window.

Attachments: MAP_v3.pdf (draft)

Short ask: can you confirm an internal owner for the POC by EOD Friday so we can lock test data access?

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20m call if helpful.

—Camila
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@farsidehealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 13:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan draft and proposal for go/no-go cadence

Camila —

Appreciate the MAP, looks sensible. Quick answers:

- POC owner: me (Olivia) — I'll lead engineering coordination.
- Security reviewer: Ethan Moore (cc'd on our side when needed).
- Procurement: procurement@farsidehealth.com (I'll loop them when we hit legal).

A couple of clarifying Qs before I share with the team:
1) For the Week 1 latency baselines, do you need representative traffic or can we start with a synthetic proxy?
2) The MAP notes a "readiness checklist" — can you attach a short version we can circulate to our SREs?

Our preference would be a July 7 go/no-go (gives us buffer around an internal demo week). If that works, procurement would prefer contract routing + DocuSign at least two business days before that date.

Thanks — will share the MAP with engineering and come back with owners.

—Olivia
Olivia Barnes
Head of Engineering, Farside Health
olivia@farsidehealth.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@farsidehealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan draft and proposal for go/no-go cadence

Thanks Olivia — July 7 works fine from our side. Answering your Qs and attaching the short readiness checklist + evaluation plan.

1) Traffic for Week 1: synthetic proxy is OK to start (we'll validate later with a small sample of production-like payloads in Week 2). If you can share an anonymized payload sample it speeds things up, but it's not blocker.

2) Readiness checklist: attached as "Evaluation_Plan_v1.xlsx" — it has the SRE checklist (latency P95/P99 targets, error-budget checks, KV cache validation, and rollout smoke-tests).

Proposed tactical timeline:
- Mon 6/30: kickoff, data access, baseline scripts handed over.
- Week of 7/7: POC run + daily 09:30 standups (15m).
- Fri 7/11: internal quality signoff and hand to ops.
- Tue 7/15: go/no-go meeting with execs (we can shift earlier to July 7 if you need the earlier date — happy to compress).

SOW draft is attached (SOW_draft_v0.3.docx) for legal/ procurement to view; it includes the standard Dedicated evaluation terms and start-week commitments.

Next steps:
- Can you confirm who will represent Procurement on routing/signature (email address) so we can prep DocuSign envelope timing?
- Kimberly, Karthik — any legal/contract flags on the SOW we should be aware of before Olivia routes?

Attachments: Evaluation_Plan_v1.xlsx; SOW_draft_v0.3.docx; (also MAP_v3.pdf referenced)

—Camila
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>, Olivia Barnes <olivia@farsidehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jun 2025 10:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan draft and proposal for go/no-go cadence

Thanks for the context and the SOW draft — quick read:

- Commercial/legal: the SOW contains our standard evaluation liability language and a 30-day termination clause. No unusual risk, but Procurement should confirm the billing/org details (legal requires the full legal entity name for the contract header).
- IP/data: we need confirmation that the anonymized payloads will not include PHI or any patient identifiers. If there is PHI involved we'll need a brief Data Processing Addendum (DPA) route.

Laura (CS) — once procurement confirms org/legal name and data posture, can your onboarding team confirm a Day One runbook slot (we typically reserve two 90m blocks during the first week for environment handoffs + SLO verification)?

Procurement/Legal note for Farside: to hit a July 7 signature target we need a procurement contact by EOD Monday 6/23 so we can prepare the DocuSign envelope and allow for a single redline pass. If procurement needs more negotiation we should shift the go/no-go out by at least 5 business days to avoid compressing the onboarding window.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwoodinference.com

From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@farsidehealth.com>

Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan draft and proposal for go/no-go cadence

Camila / Kimberly / Laura —

Thanks for the quick turn. Procurement contact is procurement@farsidehealth.com (that mailbox is monitored by Maya Patel) — they will respond with legal header and billing details Monday morning.

We will ensure no PHI in the anonymous payloads for the POC; I will have our SREs filter before handoff.

Maya (procurement) — when you have a moment, can you confirm the trusted signer name and whether we should expect an initial redline? We would like Redwood to prepare the DocuSign envelope with the SOW_draft_v0.3.docx so we can turn it around quickly.

Assuming procurement is on time, we are OK to aim for a July 7 signature and a July 8 Day One kickoff (two short onboarding blocks next week: Wed 7/9 AM and Fri 7/11 AM — Laura, please hold those as provisional).

Olivia
